reason: The picture shows glucose entering liver cells and being joined into a stored carbohydrate.
expectation: The liver cells will store some of the meal's glucose.

effect: The result shows that liver cells join glucose into a carbohydrate store that can be broken down later for fuel.
reaction: It was satisfying to see how extra meal glucose could be saved for between meals, though the pairing was obvious.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the blood nutrients with liver cells was worthwhile because the result connected eating a meal with storing fuel for later.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter had only one obvious combination, so there was little to figure out or choose between.

surprise.text: The result clarified that the store consists of linked glucose units inside liver cells, while some glucose remains in the blood.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: the picture showed glucose entering the liver cells before the combination.

continue.text: I might continue to see how the stored fuel reaches other tissues, but this short chapter alone did not offer much gameplay choice.
